tools.square-footage-calculator.faqs.5.q: What is the difference between square feet and linear feet?
tools.square-footage-calculator.faqs.5.a: Linear feet measure length in a straight line (one dimension), while square feet measure area (two dimensions). For example, a board 1 foot wide and 8 feet long is 8 linear feet and also 8 square feet. Knowing the difference matters when buying materials.
tools.square-footage-calculator.guide.wh: How to Use the Square Footage Calculator

Choose the shape that matches the area you want to measure: rectangle for standard rooms, circle for round spaces, triangle for sloped areas, trapezoid for tapered spaces, or L-shape for rooms with alcoves. Enter dimensions in feet and inches, or switch to metric mode to use meters. The calculator instantly shows results in square feet, square meters, square yards, and acres.
tools.square-footage-calculator.guide.ho: Use the room calculator to measure an entire house or multi-room project. Calculate each room individually, give it a name, and add it to your list. The calculator keeps a running total so you can see the total square footage of all rooms at a glance.
tools.square-footage-calculator.guide.ti: Enter a price per square foot to estimate material and project costs. This works for flooring, paint, tile, carpet, and other projects priced by area. The estimator uses the current shape calculation or the total from your room list.
